# Headent Client 1.0.5

A stability release for set-top boxes. Waking a box from standby no longer
leaves you with a silent channel and a frozen app, favourites can be ordered
the way you want, and hidden channels can be brought back. Available on
**[Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=sk.tvhclient)**.

## What's new

- **Favourites in your order** — favourites are kept in the order you add them
  and are numbered 1…n inside the Favourites group (player, channel list and the
  TV home screen). Typing a number on the remote while the Favourites group is
  active picks by that order.
- **Reorder favourites with the remote** — hold OK on a channel in the Favourites
  group and choose *Reorder favourites*. OK picks a channel up, ▲▼ move it,
  OK puts it down, BACK finishes. The order is saved as you go.
- **Favourites are remembered as a group** — if you were watching in the
  Favourites group, the app opens it again after a restart, both in the player
  and in the channel list.
- **Hidden channels group** — the player's group list ends with *Hidden
  channels* whenever some channels are hidden. They can be watched there and
  brought back with *Unhide channel* in the channel menu; on TV this was the
  only place left where a hidden channel could be restored.

## What's fixed

- **Standby on Amlogic boxes (Strong and similar)** — after waking the box the
  channel played without sound, and closing the player or switching channels
  froze the app until Android killed it. The audio output the box hands back
  after standby is dead, and libVLC waits on it forever. The app now detects a
  stalled audio output and quietly replaces the player with a fresh one; when
  returning from standby it does so straight away, so sound is back within a
  second. Stopping libVLC has also been moved off the main thread, so a stuck
  stream can no longer freeze the user interface.
- **Waking the box closed the player** — the "start on wake" option relaunched
  the main screen on every wake-up, which threw away the running player. An
  existing app is now just brought to the front.
- **Exit confirmation on TV boxes with PiP** — boxes that support
  picture-in-picture (Homatics, Shield, Raspberry Pi…) were treated like phones
  and BACK left the channel immediately. They now ask first, like every other
  TV, unless automatic PiP is enabled.
- **Channel list loaded twice at start** — on TV two parts of the home screen
  requested the channel list at the same time; the second request cancelled the
  first and left an error in the diagnostic log at every start.
- **Edge-to-edge without deprecated APIs** — the app no longer uses the
  `androidx.activity` edge-to-edge helper, which Play Console flagged for a
  deprecated display-cutout parameter; transparent system bars are now set by
  the theme. Resource shrinking uses R8's optimized mode (AGP 8.13).

## Notes for translators

All 391 strings are translated into 31 languages. If something reads oddly in
your language, please open an issue — grammatical gender in messages containing
a programme title is the usual suspect.

## Known issues

- On older 32-bit boxes, 1080p50 10-bit HEVC channels may still stutter over
  HTSP. Using the HTTP streaming path with the `pass` profile works around it.
- Timeshift is an HTSP feature; it is not available over the HTTP path, and
  Tvheadend does not report timeshift status for radio channels.
- Reordering favourites works with a remote (D-pad); touch reordering is not
  available yet.

## Which APK do I need?

- **Most TV boxes and phones (64-bit):** `HeadentClient-1.0.5-arm64-v8a.apk`
- **Older 32-bit devices:** `HeadentClient-1.0.5-armeabi-v7a.apk`
- **Not sure?** `HeadentClient-1.0.5-universal.apk` works everywhere
  (larger download).

Google Play picks the right variant automatically.
